description_en: Calls the ListVpcEndpointSecurityGroups operation to query the security groups that are associated with an endpoint
description_zh: 调用ListVpcEndpointSecurityGroups接口，查询终端节点已加入的安全组
kebab_example: aliyun privatelink list-vpc-endpoint-security-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --endpoint-id ep-hp33b2e43fays7s80000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListVpcEndpointSecurityGroups

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the endpoint to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的终端节点所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether there is a next query token. Valid values:
Leave this parameter empty for the first query or when no next query exists.
If a next query exists, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，取值范围：1~50，默认值：50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint to query
parameters.name: endpoint_id

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries per page

NextToken.description_en:
Indicates whether there is a next query token. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, no next query exists.
If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

SecurityGroupId.description_en: The ID of the security group associated with the endpoint
SecurityGroupId.description_zh: 终端节点已加入的安全组ID

SecurityGroupStatus.description_en:
The association status of the security group. Valid values:
Attaching: being associated.
Attached: associated.
Detaching: being disassociated
SecurityGroupStatus.description_zh:
安全组关联状态，取值：
Attaching：关联中。
Attached：已关联。
Detaching：分离中

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
